purpose: Separate genuine search demand from AI/user verification activity before SEO decisions.

rules.treatment: Retain as search-engine observations. AI editing or URL submission does not directly create impressions; suspicious test queries are flagged separately.

rules.signal: Clicks on exact brand queries or site: queries during AI operation dates
rules.treatment: Flag as possible testing. Do not delete automatically because some branded searches may be genuine.

rules.signal: URL Inspection requests sitemap submissions and IndexNow submissions
rules.treatment: Record as operational actions only. Never count them as impressions clicks rankings or indexed pages.

rules.signal: Queries from target countries with non-brand buyer intent and repeat impressions across multiple dates
rules.treatment: Treat as stronger organic-demand evidence and prioritize query-page matching.

rules.signal: GA4 sessions events and conversions generated during testing
rules.treatment: Keep separate from organic search baselines; label test events where identifiable.
